_comment: EXECUTABLE SPECIFICATION for SIRE quality rates.
Rates are where dashboards lie. Every one of these has a denominator that can
be zero, and 0/0 must render as 'no data' — not 0%, which reads as 'perfect',
and not NaN, which reads as broken. That distinction is the point of this file.

cases.name: reopen rate: three of twelve resolved were reopened
reopen rate: nothing resolved yet is NO DATA, not zero
reopen rate: reopened without any resolved is still no data
qa rejection rate counts CYCLES, not issues
qa rejection rate: no QA run in the window is no data
regression rate over issues created in the window
recurrence rate over issues created in the window
a rate of exactly zero with real data is 0%, NOT no data
a rate of one hundred percent
rounding is to one decimal, not to the nearest whole percent
a numerator larger than the denominator is clamped and flagged
a small sample is flagged so nobody reads 100% off three issues
